[SE-0551, stdlib] Form a single-element Span over a value (#88152)
Form a Span over the value in any binding, and a MutableSpan over any mutable binding.
Implements the change proposed in [SE-0551](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-evolution/blob/main/proposals/0551-span-of-one.md).
Addresses rdar://156165923 and rdar://167869600
